jobs.description: Rebuild gold.unit_price (root ADR-0190) with its Spark producer (scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh unit-price) when its inputs moved past the snapshots its current Gold recorded: the building registers at the snapshots the current building Gold was built from (pins_from), and silver.unit_official_price at its head; otherwise nothing (root ADR-0139). Only the PNUs whose inputs changed are recomputed and merged (root ADR-0180), whole when finding the change costs more than the rebuild (root ADR-0326). Its own job and asset since root ADR-0333: inside gold_panel_rebuild it shared one 160-minute limit with both panels, and on 2026-10-28 both runs timed out in it (the incremental run had 44 of its measured 44-60 minutes). Started when gold_panel_rebuild committed the building panel or joined a new price vintage, or a register Silver changed, by the asset reconciler (asset_reconcile) when an event was lost, and at 09:35 as the fallback (root ADR-0171); a committed rebuild starts the unit price bake (by_pnu_unit_price_bake). It does not join the unit prices itself: gold_panel_rebuild owns silver.unit_official_price.

assets.title: 호 공시가격 by-PNU 패널
assets.description: PNU의 건물마다 그 건물이 싣는 호들의 공시가격 이력(루트 ADR-0190, ADR-0204). 건물에 연결되지 않은 호는 nil UUID 행에 모인다. 건물 패널과 떨어져 있어 가격 판은 건물 행을 건드리지 않는다.

dependencies.description: 단가 Gold 는 건물 Gold 가 만들어진 표제부·전유부 판에 핀을 맞춘다(gold-panel-rebuild.contract.json pins_from, root ADR-0190). 단가 작업이 자기 작업이 된 뒤(root ADR-0333) 이 간선이 건물 Gold 커밋 뒤에 단가를 다시 만들게 하는 순서다.
